applies_to: ABB M4M 20 and M4M 30 panel network analyzers in their BACnet versions; harmonics and some settings are on the M4M 30 only.
summary: The M4M 20 and M4M 30 BACnet network analyzers serve BACnet IP with a fixed object list. Readings are Analog Values: voltages, currents, energies by tariff, power, power quality (THD, unbalance, frequency, power factor), phase angles, average/min/max values and, on the M4M 30, individual harmonics 2-40. A few Integer Values and one Multi-state Value hold CT/VT ratios, wiring scheme and active tariff.
notes: The manual gives no units and no access column for the measurement objects; they are read-only measurements (access inferred). The configuration IVs and the MV are marked writable in the manual.
Harmonics objects 1102-1940 (2nd-40th harmonic of voltages L1, L2, L3, L1-L2, L2-L3, L1-L3 and currents L1, L2, L3) exist on the M4M 30 only.
Object types come from the section headings: 3.2.2-3.2.9 Analog Value, 3.2.10 Integer Value, 3.2.11 Multi-state Value, 3.2.12 Characterstring Value.
Some names are printed with typos (e.g. 'Unbalace current'); kept as printed.
No segmentation; max APDU 480 octets, so split large ReadPropertyMultiple requests.

source.title: M4M Network analyzers, Communication protocol BACnet manual

integration.summary: Give the meter a unique device instance and IP settings, then read energy (AV 100), total power (AV 220), voltages, currents, frequency and power factor. Set the CT/VT ratios (IV 3400-3403) and wiring scheme (MV 3501) at commissioning, not from the BMS in normal operation.
setup: Device object identifier and object name are writable (example shows device 228).
Foreign device registration: enable BBMD mode and set the BBMD IP address, UDP port and TTL in the meter.
Device profile B-ASC; DeviceCommunicationControl is supported for a finite time only, no password.
gotchas: No segmentation: requests whose reply exceeds 480 octets are rejected; split them.
IV 3301 Active tariff is only writable when the tariff source is set to communication (M4M 30).
